payload.friendly_name: ADR-0075 slice 5: PACK and CLOSURE rulesets, one pipeline
payload.purpose_context: #554, slice 5 of epic #549 (ADR-0075 decisions 3, 4, 5, 7 as amended 2026-11-13). Validate mode and the registration load judge a pack by two pipelines kept equal by hand through converters. This mission puts every check on the kernel rule vocabulary over the packs domain objects, so one rule exists once and both paths agree; the packs domain stays canonical (operator ruling 1, 2026-11-15).
payload.purpose_tldr: Express every pack check as a kernel ruleset (PACK per pack, CLOSURE over a set's descriptors) and run validate mode and the load through the same rulesets, deleting the PackFinding/PackElementViolation/RefusalViolation converters.

options: (a) keep unmodelled as a violation and file_not_held as the excluded-file warning, both typed; wire unchanged
(b) unmodelled file becomes file_not_held WARNING and is accepted; breaking
payload.question: Decision 5 says an unmodelled file is file_not_held at WARNING, but today registration refuses it with violation 'unmodelled' (pinned in scenarios) and #554 says wire codes do not change. Keep both typed codes with the wire unchanged (a), or apply decision 5 literally: an unmodelled file becomes a file_not_held warning and is accepted (b, breaking)?

payload.final_answer: Warning (operator, 2026-11-15): an unmodelled file is a file_not_held WARNING. Pack authors may add docs and reference files that do not affect the service: warn, then ignore. The file is not held and not round-tripped. Registration no longer refuses it (wire change: the 'unmodelled' violation goes).

options: (a) inspector contents of the staged tree; inspector gains the missing facts
payload.question: Which contents does registration's PACK run judge? (a) the inspector's PackContents of the staged tree, with the inspector gaining the facts it lacks (domain value-object breaches, reference faults); the store's reader then only builds the aggregate, and a fault it finds that PACK missed fails closed. (b) PackContents built by an adapter from the store's own read: no second read, but two derivations of PackContents kept equal by hand.

payload.final_answer: (a) Registration's PACK run judges the inspector's PackContents of the staged tree. The inspector gains the facts it lacks (domain value-object breaches, reference faults). The store's reader only builds the aggregate; a fault it finds that PACK missed fails closed as validation_failed, pinned by a test. (operator, 2026-11-15)

payload.question: Which checks does each surface run? (a) one PACK with a surface profile: each surface reports the faults it reports today, registration and the compose read gain no new refusals, validate mode gains the load-only checks; wire unchanged apart from Q1. (b) full convergence: every surface runs every rule, ~15 features rewritten, Breaking fragment, open-packs org packs without a fragment refused.

How do codes and wording that differ per surface stay? (a) PackRefusals and PackVerdicts are explicit per-surface code/pointer/wording tables, each tested; FR-007 reworded (the old-type converters go). (b) unify codes on both surfaces with a Breaking fragment on one.

How do :packs tests and the whole-pack gate get real rules? (a) a test-only testImplementation(project(':pack-validation')) in :packs. (b) move the judging tests, the gate and planted/ to pack-validation or deployable tests.
One pull request or four? (a) four green PRs: golden+Q1; residue+codes+inspector facts+mappers; CLOSURE functions; the switch. (b) one PR.

payload.final_answer: (a) One PACK with a surface profile: registration and the compose read report the faults they report today; validate mode gains the load-only checks; wire unchanged apart from Q1 (operator, 2026-11-16).
(b) Unify codes and wording: one fault answers one code and wording on every surface; the surface that changes gets a ### Breaking fragment (operator, 2026-11-16).
(b) One pull request; the work packages stay ordered and green (operator, 2026-11-16).

Design per research/design-r3.md with its challenge folds (operator, 2026-11-16): rules, PACK with surface profiles, CLOSURE, PackCodes and the mappers live in packs.domain; no judging port; registration judged in packs.application on the inspector's contents; pack-validation is the Spring-free check library pack-check runs (PackLoad, round-trip verdict, from #478 the set check); ADR-0075 amended. R3-b: (i) the margin criterion is met by the nightly measurement of #578's code, re-setting ADR-0062's documented margin.
